name: Vocabulary topics
_howto: Each topic is one block inside topics[]. Words are written as: word | clue. Put * before a harder (B2) word. Minimum 4 words per topic.

topics.name: Jobs
words: nurse | a person who looks after sick people in a hospital
plumber | a person who repairs water pipes
lawyer | a person who gives legal advice in court
electrician | a person who fits and repairs electric wires
firefighter | a person who puts out fires
architect | a person who designs buildings
*accountant | a person who keeps financial records
*surgeon | a doctor who operates on patients

topics.name: Technology
words: screen | the flat part of a phone or computer where you see things
keyboard | the set of keys you use to type
download | to copy a file from the internet to your device
password | a secret word that lets you enter an account
charger | you use it to put energy into a phone battery
*software | the programs that run on a computer
*cybersecurity | protection of computers from online attacks
*algorithm | a set of steps a computer follows to solve a problem

topics.name: Weather
words: cloudy | with a lot of clouds in the sky
foggy | with thick white air close to the ground, so you can't see far
windy | with a lot of wind
thunderstorm | heavy rain with loud noises and lightning
freezing | extremely cold
*drought | a long period with no rain
*heatwave | a period of very hot weather

topics.name: Travel
words: airline | an organization that provides regular flights for passengers or cargo (línea aérea)
board | to get on a ship, aircraft, train, or bus (subir a bordo (de), embarcarse (en))
check in | to register upon arrival at an airport or hotel (facturar (aeropuerto))
crew | a group of people who work together, especially operating an aircraft or ship (tripulación)
delay | to cause something to happen at a later time than planned (retrasar)
fabulous | extraordinarily good, wonderful, or impressive (fabuloso/a, increíble)
flight attendant | a person whose job is to look after passengers on an aircraft (auxiliar de vuelo / cabina)
full board | a hotel arrangement that includes accommodation and all daily meals (pensión completa)
gate | the area in an airport where passengers wait to board their flight (puerta (de embarque))
half board | a hotel arrangement that includes accommodation, breakfast, and one main meal (media pensión)
high season | the period of the year when travel and tourism are at their peak (temporada alta)
in advance | ahead of time or before a specific event occurs (con antelación)
lively | full of life, energy, and activity (animado/a, bullicioso/a; alegre)
luxurious | extremely comfortable, elegant, and expensive (lujoso/a)
on a budget | with a limited amount of money to spend (con un presupuesto ajustado, sin mucho dinero)
overcrowded | containing too many people or things (atestado/a de gente)
rate | a fixed price or charge for a service or accommodation (tarifa, precio)
unforgettable | impossible to forget; memorable (inolvidable)
within walking distance | close enough to reach easily by walking (que se puede ir andando)
accommodation | a room or building in which someone may live or stay (alojamiento)
youth hostel | an inexpensive lodging facility geared toward young travelers (albergue juvenil)
*platform | the area next to railway tracks where passengers get on or off trains (andén)
*return ticket | a ticket that allows travel to a destination and back again (billete de ida y vuelta)
*single ticket | a ticket valid for a journey to a destination without returning (billete de ida)
*souvenir | something kept as a reminder of a place visited (recuerdo, souvenir)

topics.name: Games
words: assess | to evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of something (valorar)
boost | to encourage, improve, or increase something (despertar; estimular; promover)
cheat | to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage (hacer trampa/s; copiar (examen))
daydream | to indulge in a series of pleasant thoughts while awake (soñar despierto/a)
draw a conclusion | to reach a decision or judgment after considering information (sacar una conclusión)
figure out | to understand or solve something after thinking about it (entender; descubrir)
focus | to pay full attention to a particular object, task, or activity (centrarse)
gamble | to play games of chance for money or risk something on an uncertain outcome (apostar)
make an effort | to try hard to achieve or do something (hacer un esfuerzo)
read someone's mind | to know or guess what someone else is thinking (leerle el pensamiento a alguien)
recall | to bring a fact, event, or situation back into one's mind (recordar)
recognise | to identify someone or something from previous knowledge or experience (reconocer)
remind | to cause someone to remember something (recordar (algo a alguien))
suspect | to believe something to be true or likely without firm proof (sospechar)
take turns | to do something alternately or sequentially with others (turnarse)
think over | to consider a matter carefully before making a decision (pensar, considerar)
board game | a game played on a specially marked surface or board (juego de mesa)
*bluff | to deceive opponents about the strength of one's hand or position (farolear, marcarse un farol)
*dice | small cubes with numbered sides used to generate random numbers (dados)
*gambit | a risky opening move intended to gain a tactical advantage (gambito, jugada estratégica)
*shuffle | to mix cards or tiles into a random order (barajar)
*deal | to distribute cards, tiles, or resources to players (repartir)
*lose a turn | to forfeit your opportunity to act during a round (perder el turno)
*pass | to skip your action or roll without playing (pasar / tirada sin jugar)
*roll the dice | to throw dice to determine a random outcome or movement (lanzar los dados)
*deck | a stack of playing cards used in a game (mazo, montón de cartas)
*draw a card | to pick up a card from the deck (robar una carta)
*square | a designated spot on the board where pieces land or move (casilla)

topics.name: Clothes
words: brand | a type of product manufactured by a particular company under a particular name (marca)
clothing | clothes collectively or items worn to cover the body (ropa)
compliment | a polite expression of praise or admiration (cumplido, halago)
deliver | to bring or transport goods to a customer or location (hacer envíos)
frames | the rigid structure surrounding the lenses of a pair of glasses (montura (gafas))
glamorous | attractive, exciting, and stylish in appearance (glamuroso/a, elegante)
hoodie | a casual sweatshirt with a hood attached (sudadera con capucha)
layer | a thickness of material or clothing worn over or under another (capa)
plain | simple and without any pattern, print, or extra decoration (sencillo/a; liso/a)
price tag | a label attached to an item showing how much it costs (etiqueta (del precio))
range | a variety of different items or styles offered by a brand (variedad)
ripped | having tear marks, slits, or cuts in the fabric (rasgado/a)
sleeve | the part of a garment that covers all or part of the arm (manga)
sleeveless | designed without sleeves to leave the arms bare (sin mangas)
stylish | fashionable, elegant, and appealing in appearance (elegante, con estilo)
suit | to look good on someone or enhance their appearance (sentar bien, favorecer)
fit | to be the right size and shape for someone's body (quedar bien de talla)
swap | to exchange one item of clothing for another (cambiar)
zip | a fastener consisting of two rows of interlocking teeth (cremallera)
*do up | to fasten a piece of clothing such as a zip, button, or belt (abrochar, subir la cremallera)
*dress up | to wear formal, elegant, or special clothes for an event (vestirse de etiqueta, arreglarse)
*fold | to bend clothes neatly so that one part covers another (doblar la ropa)
*go with | to combine well with another item of clothing in style or color (combinar con, ir bien con)
*iron | to make clothes smooth using a heated iron (planchar)
*match | to have the same color, pattern, or style as another piece of clothing (combinar, hacer juego)
*put on | to place a garment on your body to wear it (ponerse ropa)
*take off | to remove a piece of clothing from your body (quitarse ropa)
*try on | to put on a garment to check if it fits or looks good before buying (probarse ropa)
*undo | to unfasten the buttons, zip, or straps of a garment (desabrochar)
